title: Static and Colony
author: Ivo Galloway
blurb: Dominic Kavanagh, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
